ai.intro: Two quick ways to get to know my profile: compare your job offer with my experience, or ask anything you like. The AI only uses what is published in this portfolio, and it will also tell you what I don't have.
ai.privacy: What you type is sent to the Gemini API (Google) to generate the answer and is not stored on this site. Don't include personal data. The AI can make mistakes: if in doubt, email me.

fit.title: Paste your job offer and see the fit.
fit.text: You'll see which requirements I meet and which project proves it, which I meet in part and which I don't.
fit.label: Job offer
fit.placeholder: Paste the job ad here: role, requirements, technologies…
fit.example:
Full-Stack Developer (Barcelona, hybrid)

We're looking for someone to build and maintain our internal web applications.

Requirements:
- Experience with Python and Django.
- Frontend with Vue.js or React.
- PostgreSQL databases.
- Designing and integrating REST APIs.
- Version control with Git.

Nice to have:
- Docker and cloud deployment.
- Linux systems knowledge.
- Intermediate English.
fit.minLength: {n} more characters needed to analyse it.
fit.notAnOffer: This doesn't look like a job offer. Paste the full ad with the role and requirements.
fit.disclaimer: Automatic analysis based on the portfolio. Confirm it with me in an interview.
